_note: Benchmark datasets (user decision 2026-10-23). dir holds base.<N>.<ext>, query.public.10K.<ext>, groundtruth.ibin (k=100), base_knn_sample10K_k64.ibin (prep_dataset.py). ext: .u8bin uint8, .i8bin int8, .fbin float32. reps: default timing repetitions (median). iterations: build rounds (null = params.sh ITERATIONS). search: cagra (cuVS CAGRA searcher, cagra_eval worktree build: uint8 / int8 / float32, needs the data on the GPU) or diskann (DiskANN CPU in-memory searcher). ref: search-quality reference for judge.py: tagore / cagra (state/<ref>_baseline.json, resident -0.01 / large -0.05) or own (own best - own_tol). bench: part of the per-iteration bench set. params: per-dataset calibrated overrides of dataset_env.py values (CENTROID_RATIO, NPROBE, ...; step C, A2 bounds: avg bucket 128-512).
